data.name: Portalborn
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Portalborn is a fully text-based single-player RPG inspired by the classic command-driven MUDs of the 1990s.

There are no animated battles or sprawling 3D worlds. Instead, you'll explore through room descriptions, typed commands, and a modern clickable interface that captures the depth of classic text adventures while making them approachable for modern players.

If you enjoy discovering hidden secrets, hunting for powerful loot, crafting stronger equipment, and gradually building a character through dangerous expeditions, Portalborn was built for you.

Explore Pocket Realms

Step through unstable magical portals into compact worlds filled with monsters, treasures, mysteries, and hidden paths.

Every Pocket Realm is designed as its own adventure. Some are dangerous forests. Others are forgotten crypts, ruined temples, mysterious laboratories, or entirely unique realms created through the Portal Workshop.

Search carefully.

Fight wisely.

Return stronger than before.

Build Your Character

Create your hero and develop them through multiple classes, attributes, equipment, and crafting.

Strength, Agility, Intellect, and Constitution all shape how your character grows, while different classes and equipment allow for a wide variety of playstyles.

The class system will continue evolving throughout Early Access as combat, progression, and balance are refined through ongoing development and community feedback.

Fight, Loot, and Craft

Defeat monsters to collect equipment, crafting materials, and rare components.

Improve your gear through Alchemy.

Enhance equipment with powerful Portal Extracts.

Discover increasingly valuable treasures as you venture deeper into dangerous realms.

Every expedition offers another opportunity to become stronger.

Create Your Own Adventures

Portalborn includes the Portal Workshop, allowing players to create and share their own content.

Build new areas.

Design quests.

Create monsters.

Invent classes.

Write NPCs.

Add equipment and items.

Expand the world alongside the community.

The Portal Workshop will continue growing throughout Early Access with additional creator tools and improvements.

A Modern Interface for a Classic Genre

Portalborn embraces command-driven gameplay while removing many of the barriers that traditionally kept players away from classic text RPGs.

Choose the style that suits you best:

  • Type commands manually.

  • Click highlighted room objects.

  • Navigate using clickable exits.

  • Customize quick-action buttons.

  • Explore with an ASCII minimap.

  • Manage your character through integrated equipment, crafting, inventory, and status panels.

Whether you prefer typing or clicking, both approaches work seamlessly together.

Early Access Development

Portalborn is under active development.

Current priorities include:

  • Expanding game content

  • Improving the new-player experience

  • Refining combat and progression balance

  • Polishing existing systems

  • Expanding the Portal Workshop

  • Implementing community-requested quality-of-life improvements

Updates are released regularly, and community feedback directly influences development priorities.

Features

  • Fully text-based single-player RPG

  • Inspired by classic command-driven MUDs

  • Modern clickable interface alongside traditional typed commands

  • Procedurally generated Pocket Realms

  • Flexible class progression with ongoing Early Access refinement

  • Loot, crafting, equipment enhancement, and character progression

  • Powerful Portal Workshop for player-created content

  • ASCII minimap and retro terminal-inspired presentation

  • Frequent updates shaped by community feedback

data.short_description: A fully text-based single-player RPG inspired by classic MUDs. Explore magical portal realms, build your character through flexible class progression, hunt powerful loot, craft and enhance equipment, and create your own adventures through the Portal Workshop.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics with WebGL support
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard sound device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad Core 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU or modern Integrated Graphics
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard sound device

content_descriptors.notes: Frequent descriptions of the killing of monsters.
